title: Getting started
summary: Sign in with GitHub to publish and manage AI resources on SkillTube. AI skills are the main focus; MCP servers, datasets, databases, prompts, agents, AI tools and guides are welcome too.

title: Limits and rules
summary: SkillTube uses activity limits and cooldowns to keep publishing and community actions manageable. The app shows an error when an action is unavailable.

title: Reporting content
summary: Report a listing or developer channel when you believe it breaks the community rules. Reports are reviewed, and a report is not by itself proof that a claim is true.

title: Responding to reports
summary: If someone reports your listing or channel, SkillTube gives you a private notice and a response window. You can see what was reported, but never who submitted the report.

title: Removals and appeals
summary: This guide explains what happens when a listing or account is removed and how to ask the team to review a decision.

title: Contacting us
summary: Contact Let's Code India for account support, grievances, copyright notices or other questions about SkillTube.

title: Announcements and updates
summary: Announcements share news from the SkillTube team. Updates help you follow new activity from developers you follow.

title: Badges and ranking
summary: Badges and ticks are automatic activity signals displayed on SkillTube. They are not identity verification, and they appear only on SkillTube.

title: Privacy and data
summary: SkillTube stores account and activity information needed to run the service. Some profile and listing information is public; private account details are not.

title: For AI tools
summary: SkillTube publishes readable public pages for people, assistants and crawlers. AI skills are the main focus; the directory also covers MCP servers, datasets, databases, prompts, agents, AI tools and guides.
